name: Hannari Mio
source:
An elusive, yet reliable onee-san who keeps the town's peace.

A civil servant from a neighbouring town who works to keep the peace. She ran into Shinano and her friends while out on her rounds, and seems to get along with them.

Sometimes you'll run into her in places you'd least expect, and sometimes you won't.
